entries.source: 1. The time available for the theoretical competition is 4 hours. There are three questions.
entries.ko: 1. 이론시험 시간은 4시간이며, 문제는 세 개입니다.

entries.source: 2. You can use your own calculator for numerical calculations. If you don’t have one, please ask for it from Olympiad organizers.
entries.ko: 2. 수치 계산에 개인 계산기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 계산기가 없으면 대회 운영진에게 요청하세요.

entries.source: 3. You are provided with Writing sheet and additional paper. You can use the additional paper for drafts of your solutions but these papers will not be checked. Your final solutions which will be evaluated should be on the Writing sheets. Please use as little text as possible. You should mostly use equations, numbers, figures and plots.
entries.ko: 3. 답안지와 별도 용지가 제공됩니다. 별도 용지는 풀이의 초안에 사용할 수 있으나 채점하지 않습니다. 채점받을 최종 풀이는 답안지에 작성해야 합니다. 글은 가능한 한 적게 쓰고 주로 수식, 수치, 그림과 그래프로 답하세요.

entries.source: 4. Use only the front side of Writing sheets. Write only inside the boxed area.
entries.ko: 4. 답안지의 앞면만 사용하고, 테두리 안에만 쓰세요.

entries.source: 5. Each task should be solved starting from a new page of the Writing sheets
entries.ko: 5. 각 문제의 풀이는 새 답안지에서 시작하세요.

entries.source: 6. At the top of each sheet of paper your country (Country) and your student code (Student Code) are printed, you only need to fill in the progressive number of each sheet (Page Number), and the total number of Writing sheets used (Total Number of Pages). If you use some blank Writing sheets for notes that you do not wish to be evaluated, put a large X across the entire sheet and do not include it in your numbering.
entries.ko: 6. 각 답안지 위에는 국가(Country)와 참가자 코드(Student Code)가 인쇄되어 있습니다. 답안지의 순서(Page Number)와 사용한 총 답안지 수(Total Number of Pages)만 기입하세요. 빈 답안지를 채점받지 않을 메모에 사용했다면 전체에 크게 X를 표시하고 쪽수에 포함하지 마세요.

entries.source: Problem 2. Steam Engine (10.0 points) In this problem, we consider a simplified theoretical model of one type of steam engine. Note that at present such an engine is used only as a technical toy.
entries.ko:
문제 2. 증기기관 (10.0점)
이 문제에서는 한 종류의 증기기관을 단순화한 이론 모형을 다룬다. 오늘날 이런 기관은 기술 장난감으로만 쓰인다.

entries.source: A schematic diagram of the engine under consideration is shown in the figure above. There is a steam generator 1 (a boiler with water and a heater, as well as a system for additional superheating of the steam). The generator may be regarded as a large vessel containing water vapor (without air), in which the pressure [[0]] and temperature [[1]] are maintained constant. The heated steam is supplied through a pipe to the working cylinder 5 with a movable piston 6. The pipe is equipped with a steam supply regulator 2 controlled by a Watt centrifugal governor 9. The working cylinder has two valves: an inlet valve 3 and an outlet valve 4. These valves open and close at certain positions of the piston. The movable piston is connected to a system of rods 7 that converts the translational motion of the piston into rotational motion of a massive flywheel 8 mounted on the engine shaft. By means of a belt drive, this wheel is connected to the Watt governor, whose angular velocity [[2]] is equal to the angular velocity of the flywheel. The amount of steam passing through the steam supply regulator 2 depends on the rotational frequency of the governor. The flywheel shaft is connect- ed to the working device (for whose sake all engines are created).
entries.ko: 위 그림은 기관의 개략도이다. 증기발생기 1은 물과 가열기를 담은 보일러 및 추가 과열 장치로 이루어진다. 공기 없이 수증기만 있고 압력 [[0]]와 온도 [[1]]이 일정한 큰 용기로 보아도 된다. 가열된 증기는 관을 통해 움직이는 피스톤 6이 있는 작동 실린더 5로 공급된다. 관에는 와트 원심조속기 9가 제어하는 증기 공급 조절기 2가 있다. 실린더의 흡입밸브 3과 배출밸브 4는 피스톤의 특정 위치에서 열리고 닫힌다. 피스톤은 연결봉 기구 7을 통해 기관 축에 달린 무거운 플라이휠 8을 돌린다. 이 바퀴는 벨트로 와트 조속기에 연결되며, 조속기의 각속도 [[2]]는 플라이휠의 각속도와 같다. 조절기 2를 통과하는 증기량은 조속기의 회전수에 의존한다. 플라이휠 축은 기관이 일을 해 주는 부하 장치에 연결된다.

entries.source: In all parts of the problem, steady operating regimes are considered, in which the angular velocities of rotation of the shaft and the Watt governor remain constant. Of course, the transition to such regimes is pos- sible only in the presence of friction; however, in calculations of the steady motion, friction may be neglect- ed.

entries.source: Part 2. Governor without the Engine The angular velocity of rotation of the engine flywheel depends on the torque transmitted to the working device. When this torque decreases, the angular velocity may increase sharply, which can lead to engine failure and its further destruction. To avoid such situations, various automatic control systems are used, one of which is the Watt centrifugal governor.
entries.ko:
제2부. 기관 없는 조속기
플라이휠 각속도는 부하에 전달하는 돌림힘에 의존한다. 돌림힘이 줄면 각속도가 급격히 증가하여 기관의 고장과 파괴로 이어질 수 있다. 이를 막는 여러 자동 제어계 중 하나가 와트 원심조속기이다.

entries.source: The principle of its operation is quite simple. The rotation of the engine shaft is transmitted through a drive to the shaft of the governor. During the rotation of the governor shaft, the balls deviate from the axis under the action of the centrifugal force; the faster the shaft rotates, the farther apart the balls move. The levers interact with a sleeve and move it along the shaft axis. Through a system of levers, the displacement of the sleeve is transmitted to the steam supply throttle in such a way that when the rotational speed of the shaft increases, the steam supply decreases, and when it decreases, the steam supply increases.
entries.ko: 작동 원리는 간단하다. 기관 축의 회전이 구동 기구로 조속기 축에 전달된다. 축이 회전하면 원심력으로 공들이 축에서 멀어지며, 빠르게 돌수록 더 벌어진다. 지렛대가 슬리브와 상호작용하여 축 방향으로 움직인다. 슬리브의 변위는 연결 지렛대를 통해 증기 공급 조절 밸브에 전달된다. 따라서 축 회전속도가 증가하면 증기 공급이 줄고, 감소하면 공급이 늘어난다.

entries.source: Electron Paramagnetic Resonance If a charged particle rotates or moves along a closed trajectory, it possesses a mechanical (angular) mo- mentum, and as a result a magnetic moment also arises. entries.source: Electron Paramagnetic Resonance (EPR) is a phenomenon in which a substance containing unpaired electrons absorbs electromagnetic radiation (usually in the microwave range) when placed in a constant magnetic field. This absorption does not occur at arbitrary frequencies but only at a strictly defined one, and is therefore called resonant.
entries.ko: 전자 상자성 공명(EPR)은 짝짓지 않은 전자를 포함한 물질을 일정한 자기장에 놓았을 때 전자기파(보통 마이크로파)를 흡수하는 현상이다. 흡수는 아무 진동수에서나 일어나지 않고 정해진 진동수에서만 일어나므로 공명이라 부른다.

entries.source: Assume that an atom has a single unpaired electron in its outer shell with zero orbital angular momen- tum. Such an electron has an intrinsic angular momentum called spin. When a sample of the substance is placed in a constant magnetic field produced by a solenoid with magnetic induction [[0]], the spin can be ori- ented in two ways relative to the field: along the magnetic field direction with angular momentum projection [[1]], or opposite to it with projection [[2]]. These two orientations have different energies, so transitions between them are possible. In what follows, assume that the Landé factor for the spin, [[3]], is twice that for the electron’s orbital motion. The sample is irradiated with an electromagnetic wave of fixed angular fre- quency [[4]], which can induce transitions of the electron between the two states with different spin projec- tions. Then the magnitude of the external magnetic field induction is slowly varied, while the change in the absorption intensity of the electromagnetic radiation is recorded.
